title: Ethanolic extract of Arctium lappa leaves alleviates cerebral ischemia reperfusion-induced inflammatory injury via HDAC9-mediated NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Wang, Mengmeng; Li, Qingxia; Ren, Bingjie; Hao, Danli; Guo, Hui; Yang, Lianhe; Wang, Zhimin; Dai, Liping
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究牛蒡叶提取物通过HDAC9介导NF-kappaB通路缓解脑缺血再灌注炎症损伤，属于纯湿实验与药理机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ischemic stroke (IS) is a major cause of mortality and disability worldwide. Inflammatory response is crucial in the pathogenesis of tissue injury in cerebral infarction. Arctium lappa leaves are traditionally used to treat IS. PURPOSES: To investigate the neuroprotective effects and molecular mechanisms of the ethanolic extract of A. lappa leaves (ALLEE) on cerebral ischemia-reperfusion (CIR). METHODS: Middle cerebral artery obstruction reperfusion (MCAO/R) rats and an oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation (OGD/R) cell model were used to evaluate ALLEE pharmacodynamics. Various methods, including neurological function, 2,3,5-triphenyltetrazolium chloride, hematoxylin and eosin, and Nissl, enzyme-linked immunosorbent, and TdT-mediated dUTP nick-end labeling assays, were used to analyze the neuroprotective effects of ALLEE in vitro and in vivo. The major chemical components and potential target genes of ALLEE were screened using network pharmacology. Molecular docking, western blotting, and immunofluorescence analyses were performed to confirm the effectiveness of the targets in related pathways. RESULTS: ALLEE exerted potent effects on the MCAO/R model by decreasing the neurological scores, infarct volumes, and pathological features (p < 0.01). Furthermore, network pharmacology results revealed that the treatment of IS with ALLEE involved the regulation of various inflammatory pathways, such as the tumor necrosis factor (TNF) and chemokine signaling pathways. ALLEE also played key roles in targeting key molecules, including nuclear factor (NF)-kappaBIA, NF-kappaB1, interleukin (IL)-6, TNF-alpha and IL1beta, and regulating the histone deacetylase (HDAC)-9-mediated signaling pathway. In vivo and in vitro analyses revealed that ALLEE significantly regulated the NF-kappaB pathway, promoted the phosphorylation activation of NF-kappaB P65, IkappaB and IKK (p < 0.01 or p < 0.05), and decreased the expression levels of the inflammatory factors, IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF-alpha (p < 0.01). Moreover, ALLEE significantly decreased the expression of HDAC9 (p < 0.01) that is associated with inflammatory responses. However, HDAC9 overexpression partially reversed the neuroprotective effects of ALLEE and its suppressive effects on inflammation and phosphorylation of NF-kappaB (p < 0.01). CONCLUSIONS: In conclusion, our results revealed that ALLEE ameliorates MCAO/R-induced experimental CIR by modulating inflammatory responses via the inhibition of HDAC9-mediated NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：缺血性卒中（Ischemic stroke, IS）是全球死亡和残疾的主要原因。炎症反应在脑梗死组织损伤的发病机制中至关重要。牛蒡（Arctium lappa）叶传统上用于治疗IS。目的：探讨牛蒡叶乙醇提取物（ethanolic extract of A. lappa leaves, ALLEE）对脑缺血再灌注（cerebral ischemia-reperfusion, CIR）的神经保护作用及分子机制。方法：采用大脑中动脉阻塞再灌注（middle cerebral artery obstruction reperfusion, MCAO/R）大鼠和氧糖剥夺/复氧（oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation, OGD/R）细胞模型评估ALLEE的药效学。通过多种方法，包括神经功能、2,3,5-三苯基氯化四氮唑、苏木精-伊红、尼氏、酶联免疫吸附和TdT介导的dUTP缺口末端标记测定，分析ALLEE在体外和体内的神经保护作用。利用网络药理学筛选ALLEE的主要化学成分和潜在靶基因。通过分子对接、蛋白质印迹和免疫荧光分析确认相关通路中靶点的有效性。结果：ALLEE对MCAO/R模型表现出显著作用，降低了神经功能评分、梗死体积和病理特征（p < 0.01）。此外，网络药理学结果显示，ALLEE治疗IS涉及多种炎症通路的调控，如肿瘤坏死因子（tumor necrosis factor, TNF）和趋化因子信号通路。ALLEE还在靶向关键分子中发挥重要作用，包括核因子（nuclear factor, NF）-kappaBIA、NF-kappaB1、白细胞介素（interleukin, IL）-6、TNF-alpha和IL1beta，并调控组蛋白去乙酰化酶（histone deacetylase, HDAC）-9介导的信号通路。体内和体外分析显示，ALLEE显著调控NF-kappaB通路，促进NF-kappaB P65、IkappaB和IKK的磷酸化激活（p < 0.01或p < 0.05），并降低炎症因子IL-1beta、IL-6和TNF-alpha的表达水平（p < 0.01）。此外，ALLEE显著降低与炎症反应相关的HDAC9表达（p < 0.01）。然而，HDAC9过表达部分逆转了ALLEE的神经保护作用及其对炎症和NF-kappaB磷酸化的抑制作用（p < 0.01）。结论：总之，我们的结果表明，ALLEE通过抑制HDAC9介导的NF-kappaB通路调节炎症反应，从而改善MCAO/R诱导的实验性CIR。
